subject: library(needs) not playing nicely with rstan

messages.author: 29ce8550baceaeb0
messages.subject: library(needs) not playing nicely with rstan
parts:
Hi all - 

Just a heads-up. A new R package, "needs" makes it significantly easier to load libraries and share code. It checks to see if you have a library already installed, and if not, downloads it and loads it. It also allows the user to prioritize namespaces after loading, so you don't call MASS::select() when you really want dplyr::select(). Simple and useful. 

But it doesn't yet play nicely with Stan. Yesterday I was getting the following error when calling an exported Stan function from within mclapply: 

Warning: namespace ‘rstan’ is not available and has been replaced by .GlobalEnv when processing object ''. 

I let the author Josh know, and he's investigating. In the meantime, the following fix that he suggested worked fine: 

cat(file = file.path(Sys.getenv("R_HOME"), "etc", "Rprofile.site"))

Cheers, 
Jim
